quotes.text: What stands in the way becomes the way.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The best revenge is to be unlike him who performed the injury.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: You have power over your mind, not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Look well into thyself; there is a source of strength which will always spring up if thou wilt always look.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Sometimes even to live is an act of courage.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Don't seek for everything to happen as you wish it would, but rather wish that everything happens as it actually will.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: The cure for the pain is in the pain.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: Don't grieve. Anything you lose comes round in another form.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: This human body is a guest house. Each morning a new arrival.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: The wound is where the medicine enters.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: Faith is the bird that feels the light and sings when the dawn is still dark.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: Sorrow is hushed into peace in my heart like the evening among the silent trees.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: Yield and overcome; bend and be straight.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: You have a right to action, but never to its fruits.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: Lift yourself by yourself. Do not let yourself sink down.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: Receive without pride, relinquish without struggle.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Never let the future disturb you. You will meet it with the same weapons of reason which today arm you against the present.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Do every act of your life as if it were your last.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: While we are postponing, life speeds by.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Begin at once to live, and count each separate day as a separate life.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: If a man knows not to which port he sails, no wind is favorable.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.

quotes.text: You don't have to be the victim of your environment. You can also be the architect of it.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Sell your cleverness and buy bewilderment.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: A good traveler has no fixed plans and is not intent on arriving.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Perform your duty with equanimity, abandoning attachment to success or failure.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: Better one's own duty imperfectly performed than the duty of another well-performed.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: Waste no more time arguing what a good man should be. Be one.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: He who fears death will never do anything worthy of a living man.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: Don't explain your philosophy. Embody it.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high; where knowledge is free.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: You can't cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: The softest things in the world overcome the hardest.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Confront the difficult while it is still easy. Accomplish the great task by a series of small acts.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Action is better than inaction.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: He suffers more than necessary, who suffers before it is necessary.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: You should be far more concerned with your current trajectory than with your current results.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: What you seek is seeking you.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: I have spent my days in stringing and in unstringing my instrument.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: God's silence ripens man's thoughts into speech.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: Confine yourself to the present.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: He who lives in harmony with himself lives in harmony with the universe.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: It is in your power to withdraw yourself whenever you desire. Perfect tranquility within consists in the good ordering of the mind.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Patience is the key to joy.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: Silence is the language of God; all else is poor translation.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: The butterfly counts not months but moments, and has time enough.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: The bird wishes it were a cloud. The cloud wishes it were a bird.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: By plucking her petals you do not gather the beauty of the flower.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: He who knows he has enough is rich.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: We shape clay into a pot, but it is the emptiness inside that holds whatever we want.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: He whose mind is undisturbed by sorrow, free from craving amid pleasures — he is called a sage of steady mind.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: He attains peace into whom desires enter as waters into the sea, which is filled but remains unmoved.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: When you arise in the morning, think of what a precious privilege it is to be alive — to breathe, to think, to enjoy, to love.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.text: As is a tale, so is life: not how long it is, but how good it is, is what matters.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: The roots below the earth claim no rewards for making the branches fruitful.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: I cannot choose the best. The best chooses me.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: Do not say, 'It is morning,' and dismiss it with a name of yesterday.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: The lamp is lit by another lamp.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: The supreme good is like water, which nourishes all things without trying to.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: The Master does not accumulate. The more he does for others, the more he has.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Not only the thirsty seek the water; the water also seeks the thirsty.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: Through love, thorns become roses.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: Let life be beautiful like summer flowers and death like autumn leaves.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: Trees are the earth's endless effort to speak to the listening heaven.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: We live in this world when we love it.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: The wise see the same Self in all beings.
quotes.author: Bhagavad Gita

quotes.text: How much more grievous are the consequences of anger than the causes of it.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Out beyond the realms of belief and disbelief, there is a field. I will meet you there.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: The dust receives insult and in return offers her flowers.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: The soul becomes dyed with the color of its thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.text: Success is the product of daily habits — not once-in-a-lifetime transformations.
quotes.author: James Clear

quotes.text: Whoever travels without a guide needs two hundred years for a two-day journey.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: Be a lamp, or a lifeboat, or a ladder. Help someone's soul heal.
quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.text: Knowing others is intelligence. Knowing yourself is true wisdom.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Mastering others is strength. Mastering yourself is true power.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: I have three treasures: simplicity, patience, compassion.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu

quotes.text: Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: No man was ever wise by chance.
quotes.author: Seneca

quotes.text: We come nearest to the great when we are great in humility.
quotes.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quotes.text: The tree that fills a man's embrace begins as a tiny shoot.
quotes.author: Lao Tzu
